import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem dominated_phase_series_converges (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℂ) (hdom : ∀ n, ‖a n‖ ≤ g n) (hsummable : Summable g) (h : s = fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) * a i) : ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  have h_le : ∀ i, ‖z ^ (i + 1) * a i‖ ≤ g i := by
    intro i
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, one_mul]
    exact hdom i
  have hf : Summable (fun i => z ^ (i + 1) * a i) :=
    Summable.of_norm_bounded (g := g) hsummable h_le
  rw [h]
  exact ⟨_, hf.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem dominated_phase_series_converges (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℂ) (hdom : ∀ n, ‖a n‖ ≤ g n) (hsummable : Summable g) (h : s = fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) * a i) : ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  have ha : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg (a n)) hdom hsummable
  have hnorm : Summable (fun n => ‖z ^ (n + 1) * a n‖) := by
    simpa [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz] using ha
  have hterm : Summable (fun n => z ^ (n + 1) * a n) :=
    Summable.of_norm hnorm
  refine ⟨∑' n, z ^ (n + 1) * a n, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  exact hterm.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat

theorem dominated_phase_series_converges (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℂ) (hdom : ∀ n, ‖a n‖ ≤ g n) (hsummable : Summable g) (h : s = fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) * a i) : ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => z ^ (n + 1) * a n
  
  have hnorm : ∀ n, ‖f n‖ ≤ g n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [f]
    calc
      ‖z ^ (n + 1) * a n‖ =
          ‖z‖ ^ (n + 1) * ‖a n‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
      _ = ‖a n‖ := by
            rw [hz]
            simp
      _ ≤ g n := hdom n
  
  have hnormsummable : Summable (fun n => ‖f n‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun n => norm_nonneg (f n))
      hnorm
      hsummable
  
  have hfs : Summable f := hnormsummable.of_norm
  have hy := hfs.hasSum
  
  refine ⟨∑' n, f n, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  simpa [f] using hy.tendsto_sum_nat
